_about: Human verdicts on links the script flagged. tools/check_links.py applies them by URL after every run (--apply-reviews to re-apply without re-requesting). status: ok | broken | blocked.

https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmwy.note: Works. BBC retitled the story ("Stanlow refinery: Essar to pay £873k over wastewater breaches").

https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/artic.note: Works. BBC retitled the story ("Leon Smith: Great Britain's Davis Cup-winning captain stepping down").

https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.note: EIA's RSS item has an empty article id, so the link opens the generic Today in Energy page, not the story.

www.zacks.com.note: Imperva bot wall ("Pardon Our Interruption") for every automated client, including made-up URLs, so script checks can't tell live from dead. Spot-check in a browser.
